blocks.text: Jab safaid roshni kisi compound par parti hai to ho sakta hai poori jazb ho jaye, aur compound kaala dikhe; poori palat jaye ya guzar jaye, aur compound safaid dikhe; ya kuch hissa jazb aur baqi palat jaye, aur compound rangeen dikhe. Hum jo rang dekhte hain woh jazb shuda roshni ka complementary rang hai: peeli roshni jazb karne wala complex banafshi dikhta hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe barabar hisson wala rangon ka pahiya: oopar Orange, phir ghari ki sooiyon ki simt Yellow, Green, Blue, Violet aur Red. Aamne saamne ke hisse complementary rang hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.6: Complementary rang dikhane wala rangon ka pahiya (kitab ki Figure 18.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jo rang jazb hota hai, us ke aamne saamne wala rang nazar aata hai. Yellow jazb ho to violet dikhta hai, orange jazb ho to blue, red jazb ho to green; aur ulat bhi: violet jazb ho to yellow, blue jazb ho to orange, green jazb ho to red.

blocks.title: d-d transition
blocks.text: Kam tawanai wale d orbital ka electron roshni jazb kar ke zyada tawanai wale d orbital mein chala jata hai. Jazb shuda roshni ki tawanai farq ke barabar hoti hai: delta E = h nu = hc/lambda, jahan h Planck's constant, nu frequency, c roshni ki raftaar aur lambda wavelength hai. Jazb na hone wali roshni aage jati aur rang deti hai.
Mukhtalif ligands ka delta E aur rang par asar

Ligand splitting ki miqdar par asar karta hai. NH3 aur CN- jaise ligands zyada splitting, aur Cl- aur I- jaise ligands kam splitting karte hain. Zyada delta E ka matlab hai ke zyada frequency (chhoti wavelength) ki, banafshi ya neeli, roshni jazb hoti hai, is liye complex peela ya narangi dikhta hai; kam tawanai ki surkh ya narangi roshni jazb karne wala complex neela ya hara dikhta hai. Ligands ko un ki splitting ke mutabiq, zyada se kam delta E tak, tarteeb diya ja sakta hai:

blocks.title: Ligands ki tarteeb (zyada se kam splitting)
blocks.text: CN- > en > NH3 > H2O > OH- > Cl- > Br- > I-

blocks.prompt: Ligands complex ion mein d orbitals ki degeneracy par kaise asar karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Un ka electric field paanch degenerate d orbitals ko mukhtalif tawanai ke do non-degenerate sets mein baant deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Octahedral aur tetrahedral splitting mein bunyadi farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Octahedral: teen orbitals neeche aur do oopar. Tetrahedral: namoona ulta (do neeche, teen oopar) aur splitting kam.

blocks.prompt: delta E = h nu = hc/lambda use kar ke jazb shuda tawanai delta E ka nazar aane wale rang se taalluq batayein.
blocks.explanation: Zyada delta E ka matlab zyada frequency aur chhoti wavelength ki roshni jazb hoti hai; nazar aane wala rang jazb shuda roshni ka complementary rang hai.

blocks.prompt: Cl- wala complex surkh/narangi roshni jazb karta hai. Woh kis rang ka dikhega?
blocks.explanation: Neela se hara, jo narangi aur surkh ke complementary rang hain.

blocks.prompt: Transition metal compounds ke rang ke zimmedar d-d transitions samjhayein.
blocks.explanation: Bate hue d orbitals mein neeche ke set ka electron delta E ke barabar tawanai ka photon jazb kar ke oopar ke set mein jata hai; woh rang safaid roshni se nikal jata aur baqi nazar aata hai.

items: Nazar aane wala rang = jazb roshni ka complementary rang.
d-d transition: delta E = h nu = hc/lambda.
Splitting: CN- > en > NH3 > H2O > OH- > Cl- > Br- > I-.
